__broaden__.እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · from among (እምነ ኴሉ ነጋድያን 'from among all the merchants'; 'apart from' is also possible there) · than, in comparison (ጥበብ ትኄይስ እምነ ኴሉ 'wisdom is better than all')
__broaden__.ትኩን: ኮነ — that she be (3fs jussive) · that you be (2ms jussive, ከመ ትኩን ከማሁ 'that you be like him') · let it be (3fs jussive, ትኩን ሞትነ 'may our death be')
__broaden__.እመኒ: እመኒ — even, also (እመ + enclitic -ኒ; uncertain) · 'if indeed, whether' (እመኒ ሖርኪ 'if you go', repeated in ወእመኒ ነበርኪ 'and if you stay')
